description: Supplementary Table 10: equal-centre matched endpoint means of m, C and centre-level q=C/m.
paired_mask: valid score in 2000 and 2025; q additionally requires positive m at both endpoints
complete_mask: paired mask and valid score in every year 2000–2025
averaging: Means of local m, C and q on each row-specific common endpoint mask, multiplied by 100; q is computed per neighbourhood before averaging.
